samples.title: Weapon Inaccuracy Stack Frame Expansion
samples.old_asm:
push    rdi
push    r14
sub     rsp, 68h ; 104 bytes stack frame
mov     rdi, rcx
call    C_CSWeaponBase::GetTargetInaccuracy
mov     r14, rax
samples.new_asm:
push    rdi
push    r14
sub     rsp, 78h ; 120 bytes stack (expanded by 16 bytes)
mov     rdi, rcx
call    C_CSWeaponBase::GetTargetInaccuracy
mov     r14, rax
samples.analysis: Stack allocation increased from 0x68 to 0x78 bytes (16-byte alignment preserved) to preserve additional XMM SIMD vector registers across nested math calls during exponential inaccuracy penalty decay (exp(-(ln(10)/recoveryTime)*dt)).

push    rbp
